description: React component for the Recommendations Page in a cybersecurity validation dashboard, including functions for risk assessment, anomaly summary extraction, and rendering recommendations based on validation and anomaly detection results.

methods.name: formatPct
methods.description: Formats a number as a percentage string, or returns an em dash if not finite.

methods.name: riskLabel
methods.description: Returns a label object with color and style based on a risk score between 0 and 1.

methods.name: getAnomalySummary
methods.description: Extracts and summarizes anomaly detection results from validationResult object.

methods.name: computeRiskScore01
methods.description: Calculates a risk score between 0 and 1 based on anomaly summary and validation issues.

methods.name: RecommendationCard
methods.description: React component to display a recommendation card with title, impact, steps, and evidence.
